up: Retrieve the canonical SMILES and exact activity details (standard_type, standard_value, standard_relation, standard_units) for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614441. Filter strictly by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614441'. Join assays to activities on assay_id, and activities to compound_structures on molregno. Return one row per activity measurement. Do not apply any additional filters, limits, or ranking.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_relation, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614441'
